_comment: Firms and plans not covered by the wawa-website spec sheets, entered by hand
from the firm's own rules pages. Merged into src/lib/propfirm/catalogue.ts by
scripts/import-catalogue.mts, so regenerating never drops them.
Values omitted here stay null rather than being guessed at.
Numbers in `sizes` are evaluation-phase rules; where a firm's funded phase
differs (contract ceilings, drawdown mode, consistency) that lives in notes,
because a plan carries one set of columns and the account is created in eval.

common.notes: Funded drawdown is real-time, not EOD · Micro scaling 10:1 · No funded consistency · No scaling rule
